note: Written by hand from general knowledge of the charts, not from a chart: positions are approximate and wait to be checked against NOAA charts 18746, 18749 and 18757. The breakwaters follow the line of rocks the tide model and the elevation tiles already show; the oil islands are where the baked land has them; the Beta field platforms (Ellen, Elly, Eureka) and Edith are placed from memory to about half a mile. The traffic lanes are drawn simpler and narrower than the real scheme and are kept west of the platforms. Lights have the right colours and roughly the right rhythms. Structures are made solid by scripts/stamp.ts, which writes them into depth.bin. Kelp lines follow the baked coast: scene/kelp.ts turns them into the canopy. Not for navigation.

areas.name: Western approach, outbound lane
areas.warn: The outbound lane of the western approach. Ships leaving for the Santa Barbara Channel run north-west along it at 15 to 20 knots. Cross it square and do not loiter

areas.name: Western approach, inbound lane
areas.warn: The inbound lane of the western approach. Ships for Los Angeles and Long Beach come down it from the north-west. Cross it square

areas.name: Southern approach, outbound lane
areas.warn: The southbound lane of the southern approach. Ships bound down the coast run along it. Cross it square

areas.name: Southern approach, inbound lane
areas.warn: The northbound lane of the southern approach. Ships come up it from the Gulf of Santa Catalina for the pilot station. Cross it square

areas.name: Precautionary Area
areas.say: Where the lanes meet off the breakwater. Ships slow, turn and pick up their pilots
areas.warn: The precautionary area off the breakwater. The lanes meet here: ships turn for Queens Gate and Angels Gate and pick up their pilots. Keep a good lookout all round

areas.name: Queens Gate
areas.say: The gap into Long Beach. 640 m wide
areas.warn: Queens Gate, the gap in the breakwater for Long Beach. Long Beach Light flashes white on the west side. Ships and the Catalina boats use it: keep to the edge if one is coming

areas.name: Angels Gate
areas.say: The gap into Los Angeles. Angels Gate Light on its west side
areas.warn: Angels Gate, the gap in the breakwater for Los Angeles harbor. Angels Gate Light flashes green on the west side

areas.name: Platform Edith
areas.say: Oil platform. Nobody fishes or anchors inside the ring
areas.warn: Platform Edith. An oil platform on steel legs in 49 m of water: solid, lit all night, and it sounds a horn in thick weather. Nobody fishes or anchors inside a hundred metres of her: stand off and mind the boat landing

areas.name: Platform Ellen
areas.say: Oil platform. Nobody fishes or anchors inside the ring
areas.warn: Platform Ellen. An oil platform on steel legs in 81 m of water: solid, lit all night, and it sounds a horn in thick weather. Nobody fishes or anchors inside a hundred metres of her: stand off and mind the boat landing

areas.name: Platform Elly
areas.say: Oil platform. Nobody fishes or anchors inside the ring
areas.warn: Platform Elly. An oil platform on steel legs in 78 m of water: solid, lit all night, and it sounds a horn in thick weather. Nobody fishes or anchors inside a hundred metres of her: stand off and mind the boat landing

areas.name: Platform Eureka
areas.say: Oil platform. Nobody fishes or anchors inside the ring
areas.warn: Platform Eureka. An oil platform on steel legs in 213 m of water: solid, lit all night, and it sounds a horn in thick weather. Nobody fishes or anchors inside a hundred metres of her: stand off and mind the boat landing

areas.name: Casino Point Dive Park
areas.say: Underwater park. Divers down. Nothing may be taken
areas.warn: The dive park off Casino Point: a roped-off underwater park with divers down all day. No boats inside the buoys, and nothing may be taken

areas.name: Lover's Cove
areas.say: Marine reserve. Snorkelers. Nothing may be taken
areas.warn: Lover's Cove: a marine reserve just past the mole, full of snorkelers and bright orange garibaldi. No anchoring, and nothing may be taken

areas.name: Long Point reserve
areas.say: State marine reserve. Nothing may be taken
areas.warn: The marine reserve round Long Point. Sail through as you like, but nothing may be taken here: no lines, no pots, no lobster

areas.name: Blue Cavern reserve
areas.say: Marine conservation area off Blue Cavern Point. Nothing may be taken
areas.warn: Blue Cavern Point, east of the Isthmus: a conservation area off the marine science station. No anchoring and nothing may be taken

lights.name: Angels Gate Light
lights.say: The lighthouse on the end of the San Pedro breakwater, since 1913. The west side of Angels Gate

lights.name: Long Beach Light
lights.say: The "robot light", a square tower on six columns on the end of the Middle Breakwater. The west side of Queens Gate

lights.name: Queens Gate east
lights.say: The west end of the Long Beach breakwater

lights.name: Angels Gate east
lights.say: The west end of the Middle Breakwater

lights.name: Breakwater east end
lights.say: The east end of the Long Beach breakwater. Round it for Alamitos Bay

lights.name: Point Fermin
lights.say: The bluff at the west end of the breakwater. The wooden lighthouse of 1874 stands in the park above

lights.name: Point Vicente
lights.say: The tall white tower on the cliffs of Palos Verdes, at the turn of the coast

lights.name: Long Point
lights.say: The point of the island nearest the mainland

lights.name: Ship Rock
lights.say: A rock like a ship under sail, a mile north of the Isthmus, white with birds. Foul ground reaches south of it

lights.name: Casino Point
lights.say: On the sea wall under the Casino. The north side of the way in to Avalon

lights.name: Cabrillo Mole
lights.say: The end of the ferry mole. The south side of the way in to Avalon

structures.name: San Pedro Breakwater
structures.say: Rock, 1899 to 1912. From Cabrillo Beach to Angels Gate Light

structures.name: Middle Breakwater
structures.say: Detached, three and a half miles from Angels Gate to Queens Gate

structures.name: Long Beach Breakwater
structures.say: Detached, two and a half miles east from Queens Gate. Open water round its east end

structures.name: Belmont Pier
structures.say: The concrete pleasure pier at Belmont Shore, with a T at its end

structures.name: Island Freeman
structures.say: The largest and furthest out of the four

structures.name: Platform Edith
structures.say: A drilling and production platform, the nearest to Long Beach

structures.name: Platform Ellen
structures.say: The drilling platform of the Beta field, joined to Elly by a footbridge

structures.name: Platform Elly
structures.say: The processing platform of the Beta field: no wells, all pipes and vessels

structures.name: Platform Eureka
structures.say: The deepest of the four, in over 200 m at the edge of the shelf

kelp.name: Long Point to White's Landing and Empire Landing
Arrow Point to the West End
